en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a gently curving ramp and stairways with stone balustrades descending through a landscaped terrace. People with hats and parasols walk along the paths. Decorative street lamps line the upper terraces, and to the right a promenade with buildings and gardens stretches along what appears to be a seaside bathing area. Printed captions in Bulgarian (using old orthography) and German appear at the bottom.
